name: automation-apps
description: Apps Mobile Automation Framework - React Native Android & iOS

scripts.test:all: OS=android node run.js & OS=ios node run.js & wait && npm run allure:report
scripts.test:all:uat: OS=android ENV=uat node run.js & OS=ios ENV=uat node run.js & wait && npm run allure:report
scripts.test:all:staging: OS=android ENV=staging node run.js & OS=ios ENV=staging node run.js & wait && npm run allure:report
scripts.appium:install: npm run appium:install:android && npm run appium:install:ios
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open

author: Pradeep Kr. Rana
